  },

  },

  },

\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=1.0cm and 1.5cm, auto]

% ---------- 开始 ----------
\node[terminal] (start) at (0,12) {开始};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2.2,12) {ebpf};

% ---------- 步骤1: eBPF探针加载 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (load) at (0,10) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,10) {kernel};
\node[labelnode] at (1.0,10) {加载eBPF探针\\(kprobe/tracepoint/uprobe)};
\draw[dataflow] (start) -- (load);

% ---------- 步骤2: 事件采集 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (collect) at (0,8) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,8) {cpu};
\node[labelnode] at (1.2,8) {实时采集内核事件\\(系统调用/调度/网络)};
\draw[dataflow] (load) -- (collect);

% ---------- 步骤3: Ring Buffer写入 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (ringbuf) at (0,6) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,6) {memory};
\node[labelnode] at (0.8,6) {写入eBPF Ring Buffer\\(带时间戳)};
\draw[dataflow] (collect) -- (ringbuf);

% ---------- 步骤4: 用户态读取 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (read) at (0,4) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,4) {userspace};
\node[labelnode] at (0.8,4) {用户态读取事件\\(mmap/poll机制)};
\draw[dataflow] (ringbuf) -- (read);

% ---------- 判断: 是否有足够数据? ----------
\node[decision, minimum height=1.2cm, minimum width=2.5cm] (check) at (0,2) {窗口\\数据充足?};
\draw[dataflow] (read) -- (check);

% 不足则返回继续采集
\draw[controlflow] (check.west) |- ++(-1.5,0) |- (collect.west)
  node[midway, above, rotate=90, font=\sffamily\tiny\color{icongray}] {继续采集};

% ---------- 步骤5: 特征提取 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (feat) at (0,0) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,0) {database};
\node[labelnode] at (1.0,0) {特征提取\\(序列/统计/通信特征)};
\draw[dataflow] (check) -- (feat) node[midway, right, font=\sffamily\tiny] {是};

% ---------- 判断: 匹配规则? ----------
\node[decision, minimum height=1.2cm, minimum width=2.5cm] (rule) at (0,-2.2) {规则引擎\\匹配?};
\draw[dataflow] (feat) -- (rule);

% 匹配 → 告警
\draw[dataflow, draw=iconorange] (rule.east) |- ++(2,0) |- ++(0,-2.5)
  node[near start, font=\sffamily\tiny\color{iconorange}] {是};
\node[component, fill=iconorange!10, draw=iconorange, minimum height=1.2cm]
  (alert1) at (3,-4.5) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (2,-4.5) {alert};
\node[labelnode, font=\sffamily\footnotesize\color{iconorange}] at (4.5,-4.5) {触发告警};

% ---------- 步骤7: ML检测 ----------
\node[component, minimum height=1.2cm] (mlcheck) at (0,-4.5) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,-4.5) {agent};
\node[labelnode] at (1.0,-4.5) {ML模型深度检测\\(IsolationForest/LSTM-AE)};
\draw[dataflow] (rule) -- (mlcheck) node[midway, left, font=\sffamily\tiny] {否};

% ---------- 判断: 异常? ----------
\node[decision, minimum height=1.2cm, minimum width=2.5cm] (anomaly) at (0,-6.8) {异常\\评分?};
\draw[dataflow] (mlcheck) -- (anomaly);

% 正常 → 记录并继续
\draw[controlflow] (anomaly.east) |- ++(2.5,0) |- (collect.east)
  node[near start, font=\sffamily\tiny\color{icongray}] {正常};

% 异常 → 告警
\draw[dataflow, draw=iconorange] (anomaly) -- ++(0,-1.5)
  node[near start, font=\sffamily\tiny\color{iconorange}] {异常};
\node[component, fill=iconorange!10, draw=iconorange, minimum height=1.2cm]
  (alert2) at (0,-8.5) {};
\pic[scale=0.8] at (-2,-8.5) {alert};
\node[labelnode, font=\sffamily\footnotesize\color{iconorange}] at (1.5,-8.5) {分级告警通知\\(钉钉/邮件/Webhook)};

% ---------- 结束 ----------
\node[terminal] (end) at (0,-10.5) {结束 (日志记录)};
\draw[dataflow] (alert2) -- (end);
\draw[controlflow] (alert1) -- ++(0,-1.5) -| (end);

\end{tikzpicture}
